case.summary: Customer C09988 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $59.67 on card C09988-K1 on 2016-12-11. The transaction (ID 3534820) was conducted via a new device (Windows/Edge 16.0) never before seen on the account. Upon verification, the customer confirmed they did not authorize the purchase and still possess the card. Similar historical cases, such as CC-3353 and CC-3356, also involved new devices and were confirmed as fraud. Consequently, the card has been blocked to prevent further exposure.
